source: corpus/sentences/bank.json + corpus/vocab/n3.json + corpus/grammar/n3.json + course/**/lesson-*.json (committed export; the DB is not read)

method.vocab: N3 registry records with < 3 distinct bank sentences whose tokens carry vocab=<slug>
method.grammar: N3 registry records with < 5 distinct bank sentences whose grammar[] carries the record key
method.known_set: the introducing lesson's cumulative_known_set, which already contains the target itself; stored once per lesson under `lessons`
